notes.title: Full Patch Notes - Game Update 12.0!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders! Here are the full patch notes for Game Update 12.0. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26887590/481477894d2004c2b083c3cff7843ae1423c0664.png[/img]

[b]New Event[/b]
[list]
[*]  The Xenosaurs have been unleashed across the globe, in a desperate attempt to finally seize control of New Earth.
[*]  Xenosaur invaders will appear across the world in a new event, these invaders are level 10, 15 and 20.
[*]  Two new components have been added to the game, the Xenosaur Hide and Xenosaur Venom.
[*]  These components in turn can be used to upgrade all existing crafting items within the game from level 3 to 4.
[/list]

[b]Increased Drone Levels and Reward[/b]
[list]
[*]  The maximum level of the Drone dispatched from the Satellite Uplink has been increased from 7 to 10.
[*]  These new levels include improved rewards such as Tier 4 units at ranks 9 and 10.
[*]  3 New Research projects have been added to the Drone Research Tree to unlock these additional levels.
[/list]

[b]New Challenges[/b]
[list]
[*]  A new Defeat Invaders Legion Challenge has been added which will run alongside the Xenosaur Invasion event, this event will offer Xenosaur Crates and more.
[*]  The Complete Mega Challenge has been renamed Mega Event Challenge.
[*]  A new Mega Event Global Challenge has been added to the game and will appear in the upcoming weeks.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]  Players will now be able to view the contributors on all alliance challenges.
[*]  Change to prevent critical facility health warning from displaying multiple times while at critical health 
[*]  Added multi use functionality to various other items.
[*]  Added functionality to buy more than 1 item at a time from the item and alliance store.
[*]  When a player adds a player to his block list, that player’s chat will no longer be displayed in world chat.
[/list]

[b]Game Admins[/b]
[list]
[*]  Players with Admin privileges will now have a new “Game Admin” label added to both their profile and any messages they send.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Fixed an issue where legion challenges were being displayed incorrectly in past and future challenge tabs.

3 new training structures have been added to the game, and as such 3 new construction plots are now available on the Facility map. The new structures are: 

[list]
[*] The Robotics Bay will allow construction of Mech units of tiers 4 and 5 and our first Mech Aircraft, the Orbital Interceptor.
[*] The Experimentation Chamber will allow construction of Prototype units of tiers 4 and 5 as well as the all-new Tactical Ballistic Launcher.
[*] The Alien Genetics Lab will allow construction of Alien units of tiers 4 and 5, and joining the ranks of the Alien forces is the Renegade Alien Hunter.
[/list]

In addition to the new training capabilities, each of these new structures will come with an inherent [b]defensives bonus[/b] to their relevant unit type!

To train the [b]three NEW Tier 5 units[/b], players will be required to complete new specialized research and upgrade each of the relevant new structures to the maximum level.

Finally, a new component "[b]Specialized Circuitry[/b]" has been added to the drop tables of both the [b]Level 9 UFOs and Plasma Striders[/b].

We look forward to hearing your feedback and we hope you're enjoying this update! 🧐

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26887590/c3d37eeac68cdc1a9af2d4a9ff3a452440591443.png[/img]

Greetings Commanders, we've just deployed our latest game update which brings the new structures, research and units to Operation: New Earth.
[list][*]Upgrade your Barracks, Factory and Research Lab to level 25.
[*]New 6 research projects available in the Offensive Research Tree. These projects in turn will unlock the first tier 5 units.
[*]4 new tier 5 units, they are extremely powerful and the profile of each is as follows:[/list] 
[h1]Strike Squad[/h1]
Lightning fast and well armed, the Strike Squads rove ahead of their forces, flushing out enemy combatants with their superior combat tactics. Those caught in the cross-hairs of their phase rifles and void grenade launchers rarely last long.

[h1]Hellfire Squad[/h1]
The ultimate in infantry flamethrowers, the Hellfire Plasma Caster is the pinnicle of man portable close quarter weapons. These devastatingly efficient warriors excel in close quarter fight operations, where their foes cannot escape the plasmic fire of their weapons.

[h1]Arachnaut[/h1]
A refinement of the multi-legged tank designs, the Arachnaut features advanced stabilisers in its legs and weapons systems. This ensures that it bombards its target with pinpoint accurate firepower, regardless of the speed it traverses the roughest terrain!

[h1]Solarwind Fighter[/h1]
Incorporation of alien tech has allowed the Solarwind Fighter to fly at supreme speeds and achieve sub-orbital flight without adverse effect on its pilot. This has given the aircraft vast operational range and tactical flexibility, zeroing in on its prey before the target even knows of the danger.

We hope you are all as excited as we are about this update! Thanks for supporting the game and we'd love to hear any feedback you have!

notes.title: Game Update 1.9992: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26887590/78af77b2143b501a0a557ca7037e7dc95da04440.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Commanders. Here are the latest patch notes for the game, with some of these features being highly requested from the community!
 
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list] 
[*] The maximum level for Heroes has been increased from 70 to 75. Any Heroes which had already reached 70 will see their experience points roll over and give credit towards the new levels.
[*] The maximum level for 11 structures has been increased from 22 to 25. The list of structures which can now reach level 25 are: Headquarters, Hydroponic Farm, Oil Rig, Alloy Refinery, Black Market, Supply Depots, Walls, Airstrip, Global Network, Security Stations and the Bunker.
[*] Level 10 Alien Sectors have started appearing in all regions.
[*] Items can be used in multiple quantities throughout the game.
[*] Alien Caches have been moved from Alien Sectors to the Defeat Alien Challenge to improve server performance.
[*] A new challenge will be running in the comings weeks, Alliance Sustained Defeat Aliens Challenge which will reward an Epic Alien Cache.
[*] When an Alliance member earns a double cache based on a high Cache level, this is now displayed properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the surviving units in the march from combat were not always adjusted properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that if units were in transfer to your Facility during a teleport would report as missing until you restarted the game.
[*] Fixed bug where Facebook / Steam friends would not correctly remove from your Shard Reactor when you removed them as friends.
[*] Fixed bug where alliance tags would not correctly display in player top lists.
[*] Fixed an incorrect cost on an item recipe and fixed some structures giving less power than intended.
[*] Further optimizations to network traffic to reduce data usage by around 60%.
[/list] 
For users experiencing any unusual issues after the latest update, we will be rolling out another update very soon which should resolve these problems for users on Steam & the Facebook Gameroom.

In the near future, we will bring all structures up to level 25 along with more content based around the high levels of these structures.  The team are also working to bring the game to more platforms, and we will be sure to keep you all updated when we have more news to share about this! 


[h1]~The New Earth Team.[/h1]

[*]Fixed an issue where the rally troop information panel would not update while having it open.

[*]Fixed a bug on the client where upgrading allied outposts would increase your power instead.
[*]Fixed a bug where all the resources on a gatherable location would not be collected if your gathering speed buff expired midway through the gather.
[*]Fixed a bug where alliance missions would show enabled start buttons when VIP expired.
[*]Fixed a bug where the background music would occasionally stop playing.
[*]Fixed a bug with some graphics being scaled to large or small.
[*]Fixed 'Join Rally' deployment being marked as hostile, which triggered incorrect voice alert.
[*]Fixed an issue where attacks on strategic outposts can be unknowingly sent as a raid when destroy was intended.[/list]
[h1]~ The Operation New Earth Team[/h1]

notes.title: Game Update 1.5 - Rallies
notes.content:
[img]http://files.huntedcow.com/opnewearth/1_5_rallies.png[/img]

Greetings Commanders, we've just deployed our latest game update which brings the new 'Rally' feature to Operation : New Earth.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new interior structure has been added, the Situation Room, this structure will allow Alliance members of rank Officer and above to create Rallies. Players will require a level 10 Headquarters in order to build the Situation room.
[*]Rallies are deployments that can up to 2.5 million in units in size, and can contain the troops of multiple alliance members, the creator of the Rally will specify a briefing period, in which Alliance members have time to donate troops before the Rally is deployed.
[*]When joining the Rally, your troops will deploy to the main Facility of the [*]Rally owner and join into a Rally deployment. This deployment cannot be attacked by other players.
[*]As many alliance members can donate as needed in order to reach the rally capacity, however each Alliance member may only donate once.
[*]Alliance have a limit of 10 concurrent rallies, regardless of stage.
[*]Rallies travel at a speed of 3 regardless of troop composition and cannot use fuel boosts.
[*]Destroy attacks on Facilities no longer prevent defenses being salvaged.
[*]The amount of defenses the ‘Defensive Salvaging’ research salvaged in combat has been increased for levels 1 through 9 for each skill I, II, III and IV.
[*]You can now share combat-related notifications with your alliance.
[*]Selecting territory sectors in the world now displays an Alliance name when possible.
[*]Mailing list can now be joined from in-game.
[*]New event type added : Dark Activity added. We'll be posting start times for the event shortly after the update goes live.
[*]Steam version now caps at 60 fps in response to players reporting extremely high frame rates.
[/list]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved responsiveness of opening windows.
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where heroes experience loss from dying was higher than expected in some cases.
[*]Fixed an issue when clicking to view Nuclear Strikes the panel wouldn’t always close correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with units being sorted differently each time a troop deployment panel was opened.
[*]Fixed a bug where the text for the deploy options would be blank.
[*]Fixed language format exception in every language file when alliance help was completed.
[*]Fixed a bug where the level of the enemy hero sometimes wouldn’t be displayed on a scouting report.
[*]Captured heroes displayed in a player’s extended profile now correctly display their rank.
[*]Fixed an issue where the world map tutorial would display even if you had already visited the world map.
[*]Fixed bug where requesting help was not boosting the time correctly for the production queue at times.
[*]Fixed a bug where some deployments would stay on the deployment screen until you closed the window even if they already completed.
[*]Fixed a bug where boosting or requesting heal on healing units could cause a disconnect.
[*]Fixed a bug where the client would be able to add hero XP to the hero even if the hero is dead, resulting in an incorrect event score displayed to the player.
[/list]

We hope you are all as excited as we are about this update! Thanks for supporting the game and we'd love to hear any feedback you may have after the game update goes live!
 
[h1]~The New Earth Team[/h1]
